evidence.note: Rails 8.1 guide: 'If you're unsure whether your code relies on transactional integrity, enabling enqueue_after_transaction_commit globally in ApplicationJob is the safest default' -- i.e. it is not implicit.
Jobs execute 'at least once'; enqueue with simple identifiers that must exist when the job runs.

rb-side-effect-before-commit.whyNotLinter: Rails/AfterCommitOverride and ActiveRecordCallbacksOrder only check callback declarations; nothing recognises external side effects inside transactions or save callbacks. Sidekiq's `perform_async` ignores Rails' enqueue-after-commit setting.
rb-side-effect-before-commit.aiRelevance: Medium-high (inferred): agents add `after_create :send_welcome_email` and `perform_async` inside `transaction do` blocks.
rb-side-effect-before-commit.expectedNoise: low -- both the transaction/callback and the side effect must be visible.

evidence.note: Optimistic (`lock_version`) and pessimistic (`lock`, `with_lock`) locking for concurrent updates.

rb-read-modify-write-race.whyNotLinter: Needs to recognise shared numeric state and the absence of a lock. Note Rails/SkipsModelValidations flags the atomic fixes (`update_counters`, `update_all`); repos may need a disable comment there.
rb-read-modify-write-race.aiRelevance: Medium-high (inferred): agents implement credits/inventory as plain attribute arithmetic.

evidence.note: rubocop-rails added Rails/FindByOrAssignmentMemoization for the `@x ||= find_by` case, showing maintainers treat it as a recurring bug; it covers only find_by.
Existing menu candidate in this repo (unvalidated).

rb-memoize-nil-or-false.whyNotLinter: Rails/FindByOrAssignmentMemoization covers only `find_by`; predicates, ENV, API calls and `detect` need judgment about nil-ability.
rb-memoize-nil-or-false.aiRelevance: Medium: agents apply `||=` memoization to everything.

rb-rescue-swallowed.whyNotLinter: Lint/SuppressedException defaults to AllowComments: true and AllowNil: true, and Style/RescueModifier only flags syntax; returning a default silently is not checked.
rb-rescue-swallowed.aiRelevance: High: agents add `rescue => e; nil` / `rescue StandardError; {}` to make errors go away.
